promises.reason: The required outcome remains a useful complete task cycle, including a finding, correction and recheck, rather than message transport or a successful turn. Native returns and scheduled reconciliation are proposed continuation mechanisms; Q1 explicitly fails if acceptance is withheld without automatic continuation. Healthy work beyond twelve checks retains intake. Additional task families may wait; the selected full cycle may not. This supports the design meaning and does not establish that the routine has run.

citations.quote: Routine transitions proceed without human message relaying or continuation prompts.
One real getff task traverses the existing cycle, including finding, correction and recheck, without human relays

promises.reason: The design separates turn completion, current independent acceptance, authorized delivery and expansion eligibility. It retains existing pipeline/AIF claims, independent semantic review, applicable technical/Dot duties and current-result validation; stale green and wrong requirements must be withheld. Mechanical structure is explicitly not semantic acceptance. No irrelevant suite or worker report is substituted for current evidence; unrelated assurance campaigns remain deferrable.

citations.quote: Acceptance proves the current result meets agreed intent and applicable conventions.
Any changed candidate, unmet essential promise, missing observation or non-matches result holds delivery/expansion

promises.reason: Durable stage-local identity, process/session custody, action intent and current-result reconciliation preserve the pending obligation across native runs. Q1 includes parent interruption, disconnected result and restart; PC relocation additionally requires laptop absence and server recovery. Unknown effects/owners hold with a recovery action rather than trigger duplicate dispatch. Pause/cancel remains effective over restart and late results. The required interruption demonstration remains mandatory; further availability environments may wait.

citations.quote: Responsibility and recoverable task state survive supported interruptions.
On a spawn-intent-only crash, reconcile the named CLI session/process before another launch

promises.reason: The preserved contract demands real work/results across two agent environments with task, repository, candidate and next-action identities. The original Codex/OpenMaus plus standalone Claude mapping is explicitly historical under later native-role authority; B must qualify a compatible actual mechanism or hold the incompatibility. This is an honest bounded qualification, not certification or a silent permission to equate two model names with interoperability. At least one actual pair remains required, while additional pairs may be deferred.

citations.quote: Different supported agent environments can exchange actionable work and results.
Preserve the distinct environment cooperation required by PA4 and the second coordination-host proof required by PA9.

promises.reason: The design retains existing Hy-Memory and separates task truth, authoritative project decisions and experience without requiring three stores. It specifies scoped sourced lessons, successor use, S2 supersession, project-B exclusion, current-authority precedence, supported cleanup and Q2 exclusion of author/unrelated memory. Repository canonical lessons may supplement missing native provenance fields without fabricating native guarantees. Historical migration and extra products remain deferred; bounded real continuity and correction do not.

citations.quote: Relevant project experience survives sessions and agent changes.
Then demonstrate a successor's use of a real sourced lesson on the selected workflow.

promises.reason: The transitive procedure/helper/role closure must ship through actual installer profiles with honest prerequisites; instance IDs, credentials and maintainer selectors remain local. S3 requires a useful independently authorized consumer cycle. B packaging smoke is explicitly insufficient, and S3 remains essential feature acceptance rather than omitted first-host work. Broad stacks may wait, but a private-maintainer-only result cannot pass PA6.

citations.quote: Consumers receive the useful capability demonstrated in getff.
S3 — consumer closure:** install in an independent repository using its own authority/access, run the same supported cycle and memory/control cases

promises.reason: Routine correction and existing authorized transitions proceed without another prompt; unresolved product choices return through the advisor/operator route. Status exposes owner, candidate, evidence, pending action and blocker. Serialized control revisions prevent new work on pause/cancel, report pending cessation honestly and require explicit business authorization to resume. Managed delivery rights remain with existing owners; no completion grants merge/deploy authority. Real escalation and effective controls remain mandatory, not an optional autonomy profile.

citations.quote: Human intervention is meaningful and authority remains effective.
Routine correction automatic; genuine unresolved decision escalates; status/pause/cancel effective

promises.reason: Every required execution, memory-processing/retrieval and hosting operation must fit legitimate eligible subscriptions or free components. The design forbids API-key/payment fallback, counts no-op routine turns and retries, requires actual account/processing qualification and holds incompatible memory or launch routes. Latest-stable updater work preserves accounts and grants without new spend. Optional paid integrations are not made default prerequisites. Open-source code or CLI help alone is never accepted as affordability proof.

citations.quote: The default supported path requires no additional paid service beyond already-held eligible subscriptions, or uses free components.
Execution, memory processing/retrieval and hosting all fit existing eligible subscriptions/free components; quotas and resources explicit

promises.reason: Core intent, rules and acceptance remain getff-owned while only enrollment/wake/transport are host bindings. S4 requires a materially different coordination host and the same cycle/failure obligations, with later host-specific arch review; a first-host pilot, two models in OpenMaus or moving the same host to the PC cannot satisfy final PA9. OpenMaus heterogeneous sessions are positively credited without certifying fitness. No second host is falsely selected or implementation methodology rewritten. The permitted first-host stage does not erase final second-host proof.

citations.quote: Core product meaning and quality obligations are independent of any single model, provider or host.
S4 — host independence:** select an actually available second coordination host against the same contract and observed first-host gaps.
